Guide & Academy/BA Lending Academy/Module 10

Module 10 of 15

Product, pricing, parties and documents

Turn a product idea into governed terms, a complete party model and decision-grade evidence.

A BA must design more than a happy-path application form. This module covers product hierarchy and versioning, price construction, party relationships, document lifecycles and communication obligations — the reusable domain model beneath every lending journey.

5 lessons113 min guided timeComplete in sequence

Lesson 10.1 · 22 min

Product architecture, schemes and policy versions

  • Separate product, scheme, programme and policy version
  • Define effective dating and in-flight treatment
  • Write rollback-safe product requirements

Lesson 10.2 · 24 min

Pricing, APR, charges, tax and profitability

  • Decompose borrower price and lender economics
  • Reconcile APR, fees, GST and schedule cash flows
  • Specify risk-based pricing without hidden discretion

Lesson 10.3 · 24 min

Customers, households, businesses and related parties

  • Model a customer separately from roles in a facility
  • Represent households, groups and business control
  • Aggregate exposure without unsafe record merging

Lesson 10.4 · 23 min

Documents, verification and evidence custody

  • Design stage-specific document requirements
  • Separate extraction, verification and approval
  • Specify custody, expiry and legal-hold behaviour

Lesson 10.5 · 20 min

Borrower communications, language and accessibility

  • Build an event-to-communication matrix
  • Handle preference, legal notice and delivery evidence
  • Design for language, vulnerability and accessibility
